claims.statement: one common finite-dimensional Q-space V and one common finite S_Q are fixed independently of targets
one representation is selected per distinct prime and repeated hits are set-theoretic duplicates
S_Q-unit status is invariant under finite field extension, multiplication, and inversion
finite rational combinations of positive multiplier logs reduce to log(q) with q^2 an S_Q-unit
a rational dependence among selected outside-prime v_p terms clears to an integer relation
positivity and the real logarithm convert the relation into log(R)=beta with R positive algebraic and beta real algebraic
Hermite-Lindemann forces beta=0 and real exponential injectivity forces R=1
squaring gives an identity involving only p^(2m_p) and certified q_p^2 unit factors in one number field
a place over each distinct outside prime isolates its coefficient and forces it to zero
outside-prime v_p terms are Q-linearly independent and the hit count is at most dim_Q(V)+cardinality(S_Q)
higher-block recoding turns fixed finite memory into finitely many edge readouts in V
the composed Henon orbit expands to a cyclic scalar recurrence with cyclic multiplicities retained
separate-degree homogenization and the projective-affine dimension lemma prove periodic-coordinate algebraicity
the good-reduction maximum argument proves periodic-coordinate integrality outside fixed bad places
integral determinant-one monodromy and its inverse make return eigenvalues units
normal extension and saturation above S_Q make q^2=lambda*conjugate(lambda) an S_Q-unit without identifying conjugate and reciprocal
regular algebraic action evaluation and allowed algebraic transforms give a real algebraic additive term
algebraic endpoint shifts preserve algebraicity while endpoint compatibility is separately required for canonical gauge invariance
selector L, M, and A readouts embed into the additive normal form and inherit the capacity bound
escape gates are necessary failures of this certificate and are not exhaustive, mutually exclusive, or sufficient
